definitions.explanation: Being elected again to the same position. Used as a suru-verb, often in the passive form ({再選|さいせん}される).

examples.japanese: {市長|しちょう}が{再選|さいせん}された。
{彼|かれ}は{再選|さいせん}を{目指|めざ}して{選挙活動|せんきょかつどう}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: He started campaigning with the aim of re-election.

examples.japanese: {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{支持|しじ}を{得|え}て、{三期連続|さんきれんぞく}で{再選|さいせん}を{果|は}たした。
examples.english: With overwhelming support, they achieved re-election for a third consecutive term.

notes:
Composed of {再|さい} (again) + {選|せん} (election/selection). A standard political term frequently seen in news about elections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再選|さいせん}される: to be re-elected
- {再選|さいせん}を{目指|めざ}す: to aim for re-election
- {再選|さいせん}を{果|は}たす: to achieve re-election
- {再選|さいせん}{出馬|しゅつば}: running for re-election

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {当選|とうせん}: winning an election — used for both first-time and subsequent wins
- {落選|らくせん}: losing an election — the opposite outcome
- {再任|さいにん}: reappointment — for appointed rather than elected positions
